tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgo zla'i bka' 'gyur bca' tsho bzhugs so// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la zhu gsol/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i bca' yig bslab pa kun 'dus las/ spyi bsod 'dus nas hor zla bcu gcig pa mgo zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bcu'i bar bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpon slob 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi phyir dang / nyin phyed yan gsung sgrogs dang sher snying bdud bzlog phyi dro srid bral ma dang chos rgyal ma gtsor bton pa'i gang bstod/ sgrol ma so bdun/ sher snying bdud bzlog rnams gang 'jur mdzad dgos gsungs pa/ dus phyis rtsa chags la song ba 'di lo nas bzung nyams gso zhus par/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur mgo zla'i tshes gcig nas lnga'i bar la yar 'then/ thug tshul grol nas nyin phyed yan skyabs sems sogs sngon 'gro'i gsung sgrogs dang / mdo tshar gcig bdud bzlog gsum/ mjug gi tshigs bcad bcas mdzad nas gsol bar bzhes/ nyin phyed yan la chos spyod mdzad tshul dbu 'byed kyi deb nang bzhin 'gyur tshe smin grub 'di lo nas bstar chags su mdzad 'tshal/ sa stag zla ba 10tshes 30la// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ mgo zla'i bka' 'gyur bca' tsho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
